transcript: The library had a quiet atmosphere that afternoon I picked up a small essay collection and opened the first chapter The author gently described small discoveries in daily life In one paragraph he expressed a memory In another he openly described the desires of his youth The writing strongly appealed to me and held my attention The style was as calm as a philosophy book Yet something in it inspired me I glanced out of the window, then returned to the page The mind that had composed these sentences was quiet But it was full of passion outside A small child ran past I watched him with curiosity Then I continued reading Words carry us beyond time Today I preferred this one book to everything else
